tcp.definition: Suction-cup working-face centre, shared with chapter A

similarity.meaning: Report section 2.6, figure 19: similar large/small linkages. CAD arm lengths give near-equal ratios; the suction cup extends beyond the wrist construction.

scan.meaning: Declared geometry scan intervals, not calibrated joint limits. Other axes fixed; plate/roller constraint only; no whole-robot collision certification.

method: Report figure 19 and source arm:370 arch-shaped carbon plate. True section over the roller outer-bearing width; circular bearing/profile distance; source-connected configuration component. Similar-link construction plus separate sampled cup TCP region.
